scope: Semantic-field, pathfinder, scientific optimizer, v22 adaptive/homeostatic architecture, nuclear-emulation and CONUS preregistered spatial-analysis branches.
batch_principle: Preserve operational measurements and reusable algorithms; demote biological, optical, quantum, nuclear-observer and UAP interpretations to hypothesis/analogy layers unless a separate experiment directly tests them.

preserve_core: gain sweep with optimum candidate near 1.2 in the recorded micro-network
legacy_weaknesses: optical/laser/quantum language is mixed with ordinary machine-learning measurements
confidence weights and intervals are heuristic rather than externally calibrated
small experimental design and architecture-specific observations are at risk of being generalized too broadly
correlation significance fields are not supported here by a full statistical receipt
v2_strengthening: split OPERATIONAL_RESULT from OPTICAL_ANALOGY and PHYSICAL_INTERPRETATION
freeze raw run IDs, seeds, dataset snapshot, code hash and per-run metrics
replicate across larger architectures and held-out datasets
compare gain/temperature/regularization against random-search and no-adaptation baselines
treat semantic-laser language as optional representation unless a new measurable variable unique to that analogy predicts held-out behavior
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: micro-network hyperparameter behavior observed in the recorded experiment family; no physical laser or quantum state established

preserve_core: hyperparameter-path search as an optimization problem
local feedback and pruning as candidate search operators
separation of gain, temperature, entropy weight and energy decay
legacy_weaknesses: Physarum behavior is treated as supporting the AI mechanism rather than as analogy/prior art inspiration
quantum-inspired terminology carries no independent validation
biological analogy receives numeric source weight despite no calibration showing predictive transfer
shortest-path analogy may hide the fact that hyperparameter landscapes are dynamic, noisy and non-metric
v2_strengthening: separate TESTED_AI_OPERATOR, BIOLOGICAL_ANALOGY and QUANTUM_INSPIRED_ANALOGY
require a prediction generated by the Physarum mapping before inspecting the AI outcome
benchmark against Bayesian optimization, random search, PBT and ablated local-feedback variants under matched compute
promote only if the transferred operator improves held-out optimization efficiency rather than merely resembling the biological story
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: bio-inspired optimization candidate; no universal cross-domain mechanism established

preserve_core: explicit distinction between train and validation behavior
legacy_weaknesses: theoretical-derivation weight of 0.95 is not an empirical probability
Physarum and resonance language is intertwined with engineering evidence
some verified/current-status claims require exact run/code/telemetry receipts
directed-mutation benefit is not separated cleanly from additional search budget
v2_strengthening: classify engineering invariants separately from biological analogy and resonance hypotheses
attach immutable run receipts to MI, GPU-utilization, loss and dead-zone claims
evaluate directed mutation under equal evaluation count, wall-clock budget and seed schedule
use held-out synthetic environments and at least one materially different model architecture
retain reward-hacking cases as adversarial negative controls
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: engineering observations and optimizer hypotheses within the tested implementation; no biological or topological-resonance identity established

preserve_core: forced environment/model complexity increase after 20 stagnant cycles
recognition that loss=0/accuracy=1 can indicate overfitting rather than success
legacy_weaknesses: post-stagnation improvement can be confounded by increased data/model/compute budget
no frozen matched branch is recorded here for comparison against continued search without forced synthesis
anomaly Z-scores alone do not identify causal usefulness of the intervention
v2_strengthening: run paired branches from the same checkpoint: CONTINUE, RANDOM_COMPLEXITY_INCREASE, STAGNATION_TRIGGERED_INCREASE
match total compute/evaluation budget
predefine recovery metrics: held-out loss, time-to-new-record, generalization gap and stability
store every failed forced-synthesis event rather than only successful recoveries
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: implemented adaptive intervention with promising rationale; superiority over matched alternatives not yet established

preserve_core: Zero-Transfer I/O and GPU-local batching concept
legacy_weaknesses: homeostasis is described partly through biological identity rather than generic feedback control
hardware telemetry and algorithmic quality gains are separate outcomes but can be conflated
confidence model remains heuristic
Z-score anomaly detection can create salience without demonstrating useful causal events
v2_strengthening: represent HOMEOSTASIS_AS_CONTROL_OPERATOR independent of biological metaphor
factorial ablation: no-controller vs fixed-schedule vs homeostatic-controller under identical compute
separate throughput receipt from learning-quality receipt
require anomaly utility test: do flagged Z-score events predict subsequent recovery/generalization beyond matched unflagged events
preserve NaN/reward-hacking/curriculum-collapse failures as training signals for the verifier, not hidden exceptions
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: adaptive feedback-control implementation plus engineering telemetry; biological homeostasis analogy is non-evidentiary

preserve_core: recorded Android preview result with p=0.21
legacy_weaknesses: the generator is a synthetic Markov process, not a validated simulation of nuclear physics
a learning anomaly in synthetic nuclear-labeled data cannot test whether external observers react to real nuclear events
p-value excursions would be vulnerable to optional stopping and multiple-comparison bias
semantic labels neutron/stable/unstable/fragment can create a false bridge to real-world nuclear/UAP claims
v2_strengthening: rename primary evidence class to SYNTHETIC_MARKOV_GENERATOR
add schema-identical relabeled control generators with non-nuclear names
pre-register number of runs, seeds, monitored metrics and stopping rule
correct for multiplicity and compare anomaly rate against matched synthetic generators
forbid any UAP/observer promotion from this branch; only an independently measured external-event protocol could test such a physical hypothesis
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: machine-learning behavior on a synthetic Markov dataset; no nuclear-physics, observer or UAP effect demonstrated

preserve_core: pre-registered CONUS time window and EPSG projection
explicit null intensity based on population and nightlights
results field intentionally null before execution
legacy_weaknesses: example incident descriptions sometimes include disputed anomalous interpretations
null model population/nightlights weights 0.7/0.3 require sensitivity analysis
nuclear and military sites are spatially correlated with population, infrastructure, aviation and reporting exposure
nearest-site distance alone can miss clustering, category-specific exposure and edge effects
v2_strengthening: freeze incident-cleaning and site-inclusion rules before outcome inspection
run a null ensemble across population, nightlights, airports, military-airspace and reporting-density covariates
apply edge correction and multiple-comparison control
report category-specific effects with held-out years/regions
separate SOURCE_REPORTED_UAP from verified physical trajectory/performance claims
retain null or reverse effects as successful falsification outcomes
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: preregistered spatial-association test; no nuclear-attraction or causal UAP mechanism established before execution

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: ANALOGY_DOES_NOT_VALIDATE_MECHANISM
new_cross_artifact_connections.test: Require the analogy to make a frozen prediction that beats a matched non-analogical baseline on held-out data.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: MEASURED_CONTROL_PARAMETER_BEATS_METAPHOR
new_cross_artifact_connections.importance: The operational variable survives even if the metaphor is removed; this makes the result representation-invariant.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: ADAPTIVE_INTERVENTION_NEEDS_BUDGET_MATCHED_COUNTERFACTUAL
new_cross_artifact_connections.operator: STAGNATION -> INTERVENTION -> RECOVERY cannot imply efficacy without SAME_CHECKPOINT + SAME_BUDGET alternatives
new_cross_artifact_connections.test: Paired checkpoint replay across no intervention, random intervention and policy-triggered intervention.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: SIMULATION_IS_NOT_PHYSICAL_EMULATION
new_cross_artifact_connections.importance: Semantic naming of states cannot transfer physical authority to a synthetic Markov chain.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: SPATIAL_CLUSTERING_NEEDS_EXPOSURE_NULL
new_cross_artifact_connections.importance: Population, nightlights, airports, military infrastructure and reporting density can create apparent proximity to nuclear sites without a nuclear-specific mechanism.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: FAILURE_MODE_IS_A_TRAINING_SIGNAL_FOR_THE_VERIFIER
new_cross_artifact_connections.operator: DEAD_ZONE | REWARD_HACK | NAN | CURRICULUM_COLLAPSE | NULL_SPATIAL_RESULT -> PRESERVE -> UPDATE_GATE
new_cross_artifact_connections.importance: JANUS should learn admission boundaries from failed runs without reclassifying those failures as support for the target hypothesis.

batch_result.main_upgrade: The third batch separates operational control systems from their biological/optical/quantum metaphors and blocks synthetic or spatial similarity from inheriting physical causal authority.

next_batch_targets: remaining historical meta-registry v-series not individually audited
legacy nuclear/UAP global maps and supersession chains
older high-confidence JSONs where confidence was assigned without calibration receipts
canonical_rule: A metaphor may suggest an operator; only a frozen prediction and a matched counterfactual may validate that operator. A simulation may test code; it does not become the world because its states have real-world names.
